character.name: Rin
traits: Graveyard Whisperer: Can understand fragmented spectral whispers, though they often mislead or lie
Halfling Nimbleness: Can move through the space of any creature one size larger without penalty
Jittery Joker: Uses constant lighthearted banter to mask his gnawing fear of the dead and unseen threats
Silent Step: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to move silently through graveyards or shadowed areas
character.gear: Lockpicks · Dried mushroom rations (3) · Tattered moss-lined cloak · Empty silver locket · 20ft silk rope · Brass tinderbox · 2 throwing daggers
character.story: Rin grew up in the overgrown Brackenmoor Graveyard, learning to decipher dead whispers to find buried trinkets for the city's thieves' guild. His mother, a grave robber, was murdered for a cult's jeweled amulet; he must steal it back to lay her spirit to rest. But the dead have started lying, leading him into traps, and he no longer knows if cult magic twists their words, or if his mother's ghost wants him dead.

inventory.name: Notched Bone Dagger
inventory.lore: Carved from the rib of a grave robber who died in Brackenmoor Graveyard; Rin found it half-buried in the dirt as a child and has sharpened its edge ever since.
inventory.description: Smooth, notched bone dagger, balanced for quick thrusts.

inventory.name: Moss-Lined Leather Armor
inventory.lore: Scuffed leather stitched with grave moss patches that muffle movement; taken from a fallen city watchman who trespassed in the cemetery looking for lost heirlooms.
inventory.description: Fitted leather armor with faintly glowing moss seams.

inventory.name: Firefly Healing Potion
inventory.lore: Brewed by a hedge witch who lived on Brackenmoor's edge, it glows faintly with firefly light and smells of damp soil and chamomile.
inventory.description: Small glass vial filled with glowing golden liquid.

inventory.name: Whisperer's Tuning Fork
inventory.lore: Carved from the petrified finger bone of a medium who communicated with the dead, it hums softly when spirits are nearby.
inventory.description: Bone tuning fork that vibrates faintly when held.
inventory.effects: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear or understand spectral whispers for 1 hour. Regains 1d3 charges at dawn.

inventory.name: Dried Black Cap Rations
inventory.lore: Dried mushrooms foraged from Brackenmoor's shaded plots; earthy, slightly bitter, and never spoil.
inventory.description: Three dried mushroom caps tied together with twine.
inventory.effects: Provides enough sustenance for a full day of travel.

inventory.name: 20ft Silk Rope
inventory.lore: Stolen from a noble's carriage, the silk rope is strong enough to hold a grown man and doesn't creak when pulled tight, perfect for sneaking through mausoleums.
inventory.description: Smooth, dark silk rope, frayed slightly at one end.

inventory.name: Dented Brass Tinderbox
inventory.lore: Belonged to Brackenmoor's groundskeeper; Rin stole it the night he ran away from the graveyard, and it holds a smoldering piece of grave tinder that never goes out.
inventory.description: Dented brass box with flint and steel inside.

inventory.name: Empty Silver Locket
inventory.lore: The only memento of Rin's mother; it holds no picture, only a smudge of dirt from her grave. He wears it under his cloak at all times.
inventory.description: Tarnished silver locket, small enough to hide in a palm.
